description: Add one or more nodes in a single step. Give each a short unique key. Positions are optional: call diagram_layout afterwards. Example: nodes=[{key:"api",label:"API"},{key:"db",kind:"database"}].

fontSize.description: Text size in px (text nodes default 20, shape labels 16, icon labels 14). Auto-sized nodes grow to fit.

height.description: Height in px (default: fits the label; icons 64)

key.description: Short unique key used to refer to this node, e.g. "api" or "orders-db"

kind.description: Node shape (default rectangle, or icon when "icon" is set)

label.description: Text shown on the node (defaults to the key)

width.description: Width in px (default: fits the label; icons 64)

name: diagram_add_nodes
title: Add nodes
